summary: Core Motion reports accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, pedometer, altitude and activity data from device sensors. BifrOSt has only a four-way screen orientation consumer in the shell; it has no app-facing motion API, and the sensor feed it expects is not present in this repo.

features.feature: Device motion (attitude, rotation rate, gravity-free acceleration)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No attitude or rotation-rate values exist. The shell keeps only a discrete orientation from the sensor.

features.apple: Derived from CMAccelerometerData or CMDeviceMotion by the app
features.note: The shell consumes Portrait, LandscapeLeft, LandscapeRight and PortraitUpsideDown with Rotation Lock. No in-repo code feeds set_orientation from a sensor (set_orientation has callers only in rotate.rs tests), so the sensor reader is missing or lives outside this repo.
No SDK API. No accelerometer reader in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/src.
No gyroscope reader or SDK API found.
No magnetometer reader or SDK API found.
No barometer or altitude API. Desktop hardware rarely has these sensors.

features.feature: Recorded sensor data and batched history
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No sensor recording or history store.
No step or pedometer data. Desktop PCs are not carried by users, so this is low priority.
Apple Watch only, with a dedicated data-collection requirement.
Apple Watch and iPhone only, tied to emergency services.

gaps: No app-facing Core Motion equivalent in springboard/sdk/src: no CMMotionManager-style API for accelerometer, gyroscope, device motion or attitude.
The orientation feed is missing from this repo: springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs documents set_orientation as fed by the accelerometer every 200 ms, but no non-test caller exists here.
No magnetometer, barometer or altitude readers.
No motion-activity recognition, pedometer or sensor recording or history.
